channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Parliament panel issues final report on 'terror-free Türkiye' bid
item.description: A parliamentary commission overseeing the government’s "terror-free Türkiye" initiative concluded its work on Feb. 18, presenting a 60-page final report outlining proposed "democratization" steps and legal reforms.

item.title: Software-backed system to compile cultural memory
item.description: The Cultural Civilization Foundation (KÜME) launched the ODAK project, making the first step to build a long-term cultural memory by systematically compiling cultural and artistic activities produced in Türkiye.

item.title: Ministry to provide support for TV series promoting Türkiye
item.description: The Culture and Tourism Ministry will introduce a new support scheme for Turkish television series that contribute to the international promotion of Türkiye, Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy has announced.

item.title: Türkiye’s free HPV vaccination plan delayed pending scientific review
item.description: Türkiye’s plan to introduce a free human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination program has been delayed after the country’s scientific advisory board requested further evaluation, according to Health Minister Kemal Memişoğlu.

item.title: Police officers detained over leaking information to major crime network
item.description: Turkish authorities have detained 17 suspects — including several active-duty police officers — accused of leaking operational and investigative information to a major organized crime syndicate known as Caspers, local media reported on Feb. 19.

item.title: US to withdraw all troops from Syria: Reports
item.description: The United States is planning to withdraw all of its 1,000 troops from Syria over the next two months, according to U.S. media reports.

item.title: UN says Israeli actions raising 'ethnic cleansing' fears in West Bank, Gaza
item.description: Israel's increased attacks and forcible transfers of Palestinians "raise concerns over ethnic cleansing" in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank, the United Nations said Thursday.

item.title: Türkiye says Greece-Chevron activity off Crete 'unlawful'
item.description: Türkiye said on Feb. 19 it opposed Greece’s hydrocarbon exploration activities south of Crete carried out by a consortium led by U.S. oil major Chevron, calling them "unilateral" steps that violate international law and harm good neighbourly relations.

item.title: UK police arrest ex-prince Andrew on suspicion of misconduct
item.description: U.K. police said Thursday officers were searching two addresses, one in eastern England and one west of London, following the arrest of ex-prince Andrew on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

item.title: US stages largest Mideast air buildup since 2003 Iraq war amid Iran tensions
item.description: The United States has deployed the most substantial air force to the Middle East since the 2003 invasion of Iraq, as Washington and Tehran on Feb. 19 engage in escalating “gunboat diplomacy” while negotiations over Iran’s nuclear program remain uncertain.
